title: VC Scout — choose the deck's visual world
question: The roll assigned The Unicorn Departures Board. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Unicorn Departures Board
options.lineage: Solari di Udine split-flap boards — airports, stations, and the old exchange big boards
options.thesis: The unicorn market as an arrivals-and-departures board: every fact lands with a flip.
options.viewport: Full-bleed black board. VC SCOUT flips into place letter by letter across a giant flap row; below, a live departures grid of real unicorns — OpenAI, Anthropic, Stripe — with yellow headers and a STATUS column mid-flip. Arrivals are new unicorns, departures are IPOs, delays are down rounds, cancellations are shutdowns; your audit reveal is rows physically flipping from corrupted to corrected.
options.risk: Flip motion overused on dense chart slides becomes noise — the board grammar must hand off to clean chart canvases inside the bezel.

options.label: Teletext Service
options.thesis: The capstone as a broadcast data magazine: three-digit pages, block-mosaic charts, answers behind REVEAL.
options.case: Real resonance — teletext literally broadcast share prices, and REVEAL is a born presenter device — but the sacred 40×24 cell grid fights your dense residual scatters and trajectory races.

options.label: Miura-Fold Deployment
options.thesis: One pull deploys a linked field: the deck unfolds from a hand-sized packet into the full framework.
options.case: A beautiful metaphor for the two-layer pipeline unfolding from raw data — one control propagating across the whole sheet — but aerospace origami reads farther from a VC audience's world than a market board.

options.label: Endurance Livery Garage
options.lineage: Gulf and Martini endurance-racing identity systems
options.thesis: The model tournament as a 24-hour race: stripes as wayfinding, roundels as focus, the pit board calling laps.
options.case: Five teammates as five stints is fun and the tournament race fits, but racing identity says speed, not judgment — weaker clarity for a story whose hero is the audit.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The polished dark analytics keynote — navy ground, accent chips, stat tiles, smooth animated charts — executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: What your current decks already are, rebuilt at full craft with live animated charts instead of PNGs.
